paragraphs: The owners of Yenny's Cleaning spent two years working for someone else, learning everything they could in that time so they could open their own business.
Then the three owners started their own company, beginning with residential homes and later moving into commercial work.
Today we serve commercial companies and private clients across Bend and Sunriver — always focused on quality work and quality customer service.
